name: Surf AI
steps: Open asksurf.ai and sign up. Surf's chief executive has warned about impersonators: "The only official link is https://asksurf.ai. The account is @SurfAIHQ."
Use the free plan first to see whether the tool is worth paying for. It includes limited research and three deep research sessions a week.
If you buy a plan, Waves come with it, and higher plans earn more.
Track your Waves on the leaderboard page, and share your referral link if you want the referral reward.
what: Surf, the crypto AI assistant, promises no airdrop. Its Waves points have paid out as discounts, and its SurfBoard NFT went to annual subscribers.
behind: Surf is run by Cybertino Inc., a Delaware company. Its team page names Ryan Li as co-founder and chief executive, and Fortune names four co-founders. On 10 December 2025 Fortune reported that Surf "raised $15 million from Pantera Capital, with participation from Coinbase Ventures and Digital Currency Group", and Surf's own announcement confirms the round.
